blocks.text: Ko'p frazali fe'llar to'ldiruvchi oladi: put out **a fire** (yong'inni o'chirmoq), give up **your job** (ishni tashlamoq), fill in **a form** (anketani to'ldirmoq). O'zbek tilida to'ldiruvchi doim fe'ldan oldin turadi: «yong'in**ni** o'chirdi». Ingliz tilida esa frazali fe'lning to'ldiruvchisi ikki joyda kelishi mumkin: kichik so'zdan **keyin** yoki fe'l bilan kichik so'z **o'rtasida**. Qaysi biri — to'ldiruvchi ot yoki olmosh ekaniga bog'liq. (→ 115-dars)

Qoida: to'ldiruvchi **ot** bo'lsa, ikkala tartib ham to'g'ri: turn off the TV = turn the TV off. To'ldiruvchi **olmosh** (it, them, me, you, him, her, us) bo'lsa — faqat o'rtada: turn **it** off. «turn off it» — xato. To'ldiruvchi **uzun** bo'lsa (bir necha so'z), odatda kichik so'zdan keyin qo'yiladi: Turn off **all the lights in the house**.

items.text: Can you **turn** the radio **down**? I'm on the phone.
Where's my jacket? — I **hung it up** in the hall.
These shoes are lovely. Can I **try them on**?
items.translation: Bu tufli juda chiroyli. **Kiyib ko'rsam** maylimi?

blocks.text: Frazali fe'l va predlogli fe'l: farqi

Har qanday «fe'l + kichik so'z» ham frazali fe'l emas. **look at**, **listen to**, **look for**, **look after**, **wait for** — fe'l + predlog (→ 113-dars). Ularda to'ldiruvchi, hatto olmosh ham, doim predlogdan **keyin** keladi: look **at it**, look **after them** («look it at» — xato). Frazali fe'lda esa olmosh **o'rtada**: look **it** up. Solishtiring: look **for** your keys → look **for them** (predlog); look **up** a word → look **it up** (frazali fe'l).

rows: look up the word / look the word up
turn down the offer / turn the offer down
pick up the kids / pick the kids up

items.text: I don't know this word — I'll **look it up**.
I've lost my glasses. Can you help me **look for them**?
items.translation: Ko'zoynagimni yo'qotib qo'ydim. Ularni **qidirishga** yordam berasizmi?

items.text: Could you **pick** me **up** from the station at seven?
The match was **called off** because of the snow.
Don't **put** it **off** until tomorrow — do it now.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «Put on it.» → Put **it on**; «Turn off them.» → Turn **them off**; «Pick up me at six.» → Pick **me up**; «Open the light.», «Close the TV.» → **Turn on** the light, **Turn off** the TV («chiroqni och» so'zma-so'z tarjimasi — texnika uchun turn on / off); «Fill the form.» → Fill **in** the form; «I'm looking it for.» → I'm looking **for it** (predlogli fe'l); «Wear your coat!» → **Put on** your coat! — **wear** — kiyib yurmoq (holat), **put on** — kiymoq (harakat).

Eslab qolish: **olmosh — o'rtada**: put **it** on, turn **them** off, give **it** back. Lug'atda frazali fe'l «put sth on» ko'rinishida yozilsa (sth = something), to'ldiruvchini o'rtaga qo'yish mumkin; «look for sth» ko'rinishida yozilsa — faqat oxirida.
Bog'liq darslar: → 113-dars (listen to, look at — fe'l + predlog), 114–115-darslar (frazali fe'llar 1–2), 121-dars (to'ldiruvchisiz frazali fe'llar ro'yxati).

rows: turn the TV off / turn off the TV
turn off all the lights in the house

examples.title: Clothes: **put on**, **take off**, **try on**
examples.description: Kiyim bilan bog'liq frazali fe'llar: put on, take off, try on, do up, hang up, pick up. Ot ikkala joyda ham turishi mumkin, olmosh — faqat o'rtada: try **them** on.

sentences.text: **Put on** your coat — it's freezing outside.
Please **take** your shoes **off** before you come in.
These jeans look nice. Can I **try them on**?
sentences.translation: Bu jinsi chiroyli ekan. **Kiyib ko'rsam** maylimi?

sentences.text: Madina **tried on** five dresses but didn't buy any of them.
sentences.translation: Madina beshta ko'ylakni **kiyib ko'rdi**, lekin birortasini ham olmadi.

sentences.text: **Do** your jacket **up** — the wind is really cold.
Bekzod **took off** his tie as soon as he got home.
Your hat is on the floor — **pick it up**, please.
sentences.translation: Shapkang polda yotibdi — uni **olib qo'y**, iltimos.

sentences.text: **Hang** your wet coat **up** in the bathroom so it can dry.
sentences.translation: Ho'l paltoing qurisin, uni hammomga **ilib qo'y**.

sentences.text: I bought a new suit, but when I **put it on** at home, it was too small.
sentences.translation: Yangi kostyum sotib oldim, lekin uyda **kiyib ko'rsam**, kichik ekan.

sentences.text: The children **took off** their wet boots and left them by the door.
sentences.translation: Bolalar ho'l etiklarini **yechib**, eshik yonida qoldirishdi.

examples.title: Devices: **turn on**, **switch off**, **turn down**
examples.description: Texnika va uy: turn on / off, switch on / off, turn up / down, plug in, put out. O'zbekcha «chiroqni och / yop» emas — **turn on / turn off**.

sentences.text: Could you **turn on** the light? I can't see anything.
Don't forget to **switch off** your computer when you leave.
The music is too loud — please **turn it down**.
I can't hear the news. Can you **turn** the TV **up** a bit?
Grandma always **turns off** the gas before she goes to bed.
sentences.translation: Buvim yotishdan oldin doim gazni **o'chirib qo'yadi**.

sentences.text: My phone is almost dead. Where can I **plug** it **in**?
sentences.translation: Telefonimning quvvati deyarli tugadi. Uni qayerga **ulasam** bo'ladi?

sentences.text: It's cold in the flat — let's **turn** the heating **up**.
When the film started, Emma **switched** her phone **off**.
The firefighters **put out** the fire in twenty minutes.
I **turned** the oven **on** ten minutes ago, so it should be hot now.
sentences.translation: Duxovkani o'n daqiqa oldin **yoqqanman**, hozir qizigan bo'lsa kerak.

examples.title: Paper: **fill in**, **write down**, **hand in**
examples.description: Qog'oz va ma'lumot: fill in, write down, look up, hand in, cross out, print out, read out, work out.

sentences.text: Before you see the doctor, **fill in** this short questionnaire about your health.
sentences.translation: Shifokor qabuliga kirishdan oldin sog'lig'ingiz haqidagi shu qisqa so'rovnomani **to'ldiring**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **looked up** the train times on the internet.
Can you **write down** your address for me?
All students must **hand in** their essays by Friday.
If you make a mistake, just **cross it out** and write the correct answer.
sentences.translation: Xato qilsangiz, uni **chizib tashlang** va to'g'ri javobni yozing.

sentences.text: Sarah **printed out** the boarding passes before going to the airport.
sentences.translation: Sara aeroportga borishdan oldin bort taloblarini **chop etib oldi**.

sentences.text: The teacher asked Aziz to **read** his story **out** to the class.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchi Azizdan hikoyasini sinfga **ovoz chiqarib o'qib berishni** so'radi.

sentences.text: Wait a second, let me **write it down** before I forget.
This maths problem is too difficult — I can't **work it out**.
sentences.translation: Bu matematika masalasi juda qiyin — uni **yecha olmayapman**.

sentences.text: Have you **filled** the application **in** yet? The deadline is tomorrow.

examples.title: Tidying up: **put away**, **throw away**, **pick up**
examples.description: Uyni yig'ishtirish: put away, throw away, pick up, put back, put down, take out, tidy up, knock down.

sentences.text: **Put** your toys **away** — it's time for bed.
Don't **throw away** those boxes — we can use them when we move.
Who's going to **take out** the rubbish tonight?
There's a piece of paper on the floor. Could you **pick it up**?
When you've finished with the scissors, **put them back** in the drawer.
sentences.translation: Qaychi bilan ishingiz tugagach, uni tortmaga **joyiga qo'ying**.

sentences.text: Our guests are coming at six, so let's **tidy up** the living room.
sentences.translation: Mehmonlarimiz soat oltida keladi, keling, mehmonxonani **yig'ishtiraylik**.

sentences.text: Madina **threw** her old notebooks **away** after the exams.
sentences.translation: Madina imtihonlardan keyin eski daftarlarini **tashlab yubordi**.

sentences.text: **Put down** that knife — you might cut yourself!
I **took** some money **out** at the cashpoint near the bank.
The old cinema was **knocked down**, and a shopping centre was built there.
sentences.translation: Eski kinoteatr **buzib tashlandi** va o'rniga savdo markazi qurildi.

examples.title: People: **wake me up**, **pick you up**, **let us down**
examples.description: Odamlar bilan: wake up, pick up, drop off, let down, bring up, see off, call back. To'ldiruvchi ko'pincha olmosh (me, you, him, us) — u o'rtada turadi.

sentences.text: Please **wake me up** at six — I've got an early flight.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, meni soat oltida **uyg'oting** — erta tongda reysim bor.

sentences.text: I'll **pick you up** from the airport — just send me your flight number.
sentences.translation: Seni aeroportdan **olib ketaman** — reys raqamingni yuborsang bo'ldi.

sentences.text: Bekzod promised to help, but he **let us down** again.
sentences.translation: Bekzod yordam berishga va'da berdi, lekin yana **umidimizni puchga chiqardi**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza was **brought up** by her grandparents in a village near Khiva.
sentences.translation: Dilnozani Xiva yaqinidagi qishloqda bobosi va buvisi **tarbiyalagan**.

sentences.text: The whole family went to the station to **see** Aziz **off**.
sentences.translation: Butun oila Azizni **kuzatib qo'yish** uchun vokzalga bordi.

sentences.text: Mr Brown is in a meeting. Can he **call you back** in an hour?
sentences.translation: Janob Braun yig'ilishda. U sizga bir soatdan keyin **qayta qo'ng'iroq qilsa** bo'ladimi?

sentences.text: The noise from the street **woke** the baby **up** again.
Don't worry, I won't **let you down**.
Sarah's parents **brought** her **up** to be polite and kind.
sentences.translation: Saraning ota-onasi uni xushmuomala va mehribon qilib **tarbiyalashgan**.

sentences.text: Could you **drop** me **off** at the corner, please?

examples.title: Plans: **put off**, **call off**, **turn down**
examples.description: Reja va qarorlar: put off (keyinga qoldirmoq), call off (bekor qilmoq), give up (tashlamoq), turn down (rad etmoq), sort out (hal qilmoq), find out (bilib olmoq).

sentences.text: We had to **put off** the wedding because Grandma was ill.
sentences.translation: Buvim kasal bo'lgani uchun to'yni **keyinga qoldirishga** majbur bo'ldik.

sentences.text: The concert was **called off** at the last minute.
James **gave up** his job in London and moved to the countryside.
sentences.translation: Jeyms Londondagi ishini **tashlab**, qishloqqa ko'chib ketdi.

sentences.text: They offered Madina a job in Moscow, but she **turned it down**.
sentences.translation: Madinaga Moskvadan ish taklif qilishdi, lekin u **rad etdi**.

sentences.text: Don't worry about the tickets — I'll **sort it out**.
sentences.translation: Chiptalar haqida xavotir olmang — men **hal qilaman**.

sentences.text: Can you **find out** what time the museum opens?
I keep **putting off** my visit to the dentist.
Aziz has finally **given up** sugar in his tea.
If it rains, we'll **call off** the picnic and stay at home.
sentences.translation: Yomg'ir yog'sa, piknikni **bekor qilib**, uyda qolamiz.

sentences.text: Emma **turned down** the invitation because she had too much work.
sentences.translation: Emma ishi ko'pligi uchun taklifni **rad etdi**.

examples.title: Pronoun in the middle: **turn it off**, **put them away**
examples.description: Dialog: ona va o'g'il. Olmosh (it, them) frazali fe'lning o'rtasida keladi: turn **it** off, pick **them** up, fill **it** in — «turn off it» emas.

sentences.text: — Aziz, the TV is still on. **Turn it off**, please.
sentences.translation: — Aziz, televizor hali ham yoniq. Uni **o'chir**, iltimos.

sentences.text: — OK, Mum, I'm **turning it off** now.
— And your clothes are on the floor. **Pick them up**!
sentences.translation: — Kiyimlaring ham polda yotibdi. Ularni **yig'ishtirib ol**!

sentences.text: — I've already **picked them up** and **put them away**.
— Good. Have you **filled in** the form for the school trip?
— Not yet. Can you help me **fill it in**?
— Of course. Where is it? Did you **throw it away**?
— No, I think Dad **put it down** somewhere in the kitchen.
sentences.translation: — Yo'q, menimcha, dadam uni oshxonada bir joyga **qo'yib qo'ydi**.

sentences.text: — Found it! And your jacket — **put it on**, we're leaving.
— Wait a minute, I'm **putting** my shoes **on**!

examples.title: **look it up** or **look for it**?
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: frazali fe'l (olmosh o'rtada: look **it** up, turn **it** off) va fe'l + predlog (olmosh oxirida: look **for it**, look **after them**, listen **to it**).

sentences.text: If you don't know a word, **look it up** in the dictionary.
I've lost my keys. Can you help me **look for them**?
sentences.translation: Kalitlarimni yo'qotib qo'ydim. Ularni **qidirishga** yordam berasizmi?

sentences.text: Who **looks after** your children when you're at work?
My grandmother **looks after them** — she lives next door.
That's a beautiful photo. Can I **look at it**?
We **listened to** the new album and then **turned it off**.
Aziz is **waiting for** his sister — she'll **pick him up** after school.
sentences.translation: Aziz opasini **kutyapti** — u maktabdan keyin uni **olib ketadi**.

sentences.text: When the teacher **asked for** our homework, Tom said he'd **handed it in** already.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchi uy vazifamizni **so'raganda**, Tom uni allaqachon **topshirganini** aytdi.

sentences.text: These forms are for new students — please **fill them in** and **give them back** to me.
sentences.translation: Bu anketalar yangi talabalar uchun — iltimos, ularni **to'ldirib**, menga **qaytarib bering**.

sentences.text: James **asked about** the job and then **thought it over** for a week.
sentences.translation: Jeyms ish **haqida so'radi**, keyin bir hafta davomida uni **o'ylab ko'rdi**.
